title: Geno Smith, Demario Davis, Minkah Fitzpatrick are among Jets captains; Garrett Wilson is not

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Geno Smith, Demario Davis, Minkah Fitzpatrick are among Jets captains; Garrett Wilson is not
sources.description: The Jets worked to bring in more experienced players after a young roster struggled in 2025 and three of those players were named team captains on Thursday.
